items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I took it down to Bess Berman, who owned the record company at the time.

ctx.x: now, didn't you also write some songs for Mahalia Jackson?

Yeah. What's -- I got that record. I got some of those records too. What was her first one? You see, I wrote a song called, 'Will The Day Ever Come When I Can Rest,' and I took it down to Bess Berman, who owned the record company at the time.
